independent_numerical_recalculation.method: Independent componentwise cross products; remove target row and maximize signed physical wrench directly with five zero equalities; SciPy highs-ipm, not builder alpha/scaled-row formulation. No builder evaluate/matrix/axes called for numerical replay.

unit_and_frame_review.source_geometry_units: WP03 bus dimensions mm are divided by 2000 to form half lengths in m; nozzle positions and COM are m.
unit_and_frame_review.wrench_definition: [sum(u_i*d_i); sum((r_i-c) cross (u_i*d_i))], all vectors expressed in S; torque reference is combined COM, even though S origin is bus geometric center.
unit_and_frame_review.direction: Force ON spacecraft, not exhaust. Invalid direction-kind refused.
unit_and_frame_review.numerical_scaling: Builder divides moment rows by 0.1 m for conditioning and converts target capacity back; independent unscaled direct objectives agree.

positive_authority_and_fault_review.independent_full_rank_counterexample: 12-jet first stuck-closed failure retains rank 6 but loses pure +Fx and +Tz.
positive_authority_and_fault_review.single_failure_model: One jet stuck CLOSED at zero thrust; all other independently commanded average-force bounds retained.

local_records.model: AAC RW400 30 mN m s candidate

research_sim10.documented_basis: 3 x 100 mN m s study class

wheel_and_power_review.power_design_implication: Motor supply is not the 24 V servo rail; DC/DC, per-branch protection/return/concurrency and source revision remain design inputs. 15 W is a per-unit brochure maximum, not a frozen aggregate rail or duration.

public_sources.scope: Current official complete specification table independently opened; 15/30/50 options, supply rails, nominal/peak powers, table torque, temperature.

Both PDF pages text independently read; 2021-11-15 edition, braking/table distinction and supply values. Screenshot request unavailable; table values also independently available as official webpage text.

legacy_scalar_budget_review.sim08_pair_formula: tau=2*F*l for two equal opposed jets with individual moment arm l
legacy_scalar_budget_review.scope: Documentation correctly preserves a factor-of-two force-definition ambiguity instead of silently importing a scalar effective torque into current hardware.

findings.problem: Boolean/string physical numbers were coerced by numpy; force_max_N=True became 1 N.
findings.resolution: Strict physical scalar type validation now refuses bool/string in force, position, direction and COM.

findings.problem: Empty required_evidence vacuously returned complete; absent mode contract could skip fresh mode generation.
findings.resolution: Empty/duplicate/invalid requirements fail closed. Missing contract raises at entry before result generation.

findings.problem: M03/M05/M07 requirements did not explicitly require task force/moment allocation authority and margin evidence.
findings.resolution: Added task_wrench_authority_verified to all three modes; null blocks each even if other declared fields are true.

observations: The 33 Boolean evidence fields are a design checklist/classifier, not hardware measurements or a validated runtime state machine. Future evidence must be bound to mode, actuator revision, COM/posture, timing and source hashes.
The current intake intentionally remains unbound. Catalogue CPOD/MiPS counts and box/connector coordinates are not installed nozzle locations.
All 9 current modes remain BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_REQUIREMENT and physical permission false.
COM-offset spot checks are not robustness coverage over captured-stack mass/inertia/COM intervals.
Stuck-open isolation, valve timing, pulse quantization, command/telemetry age, wheel saturation/zero-crossing and common power faults remain unverified.
No structural/plume/thermal/radiation qualification or electrical power-up readiness follows from this static result.
Source hashes and all 13 builder-owned receipt pins matched after repairs; earlier transient hash mismatch during builder edits was not accepted as a final result.

reviewer_conclusion.next_engineering_work: Bind actual wheels/nozzles/ICD and mode-specific wrench, impulse, power and COM evidence before mission authority evaluation.
